rows.note: For the camera sense, this is the all-purpose choice for the lens or digital zoom feature.

example.english: This camera’s zoom function is great—you can even zoom in on distant views.
example.traditional: 呢部相機嘅變焦功能好正，影遠景都可以拉近嚟睇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 ge3 bin3 ziu1 gung1 nang4 hou2 zeng3 jing2 jyun5 ging2 dou1 ho2 ji5 laai1 gan6 lai4 tai2

rows.note: Use this for a video call rather than for the camera feature or its sound.

example.english: Let’s have a zoom video call tonight to discuss the plan.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚用視像通話傾吓份計劃啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 jung6 si6 zoeng6 tung1 waa6 king1 haa5 fan2 gai3 waak6 laa1

rows.note: Use this for the rushing or whizzing sound made by something moving very fast.

example.english: The bicycle shot past me with a loud zoom.
example.traditional: 架單車飛過身邊，發出嗖嗖聲。
example.jyutping: gaa3 daan1 ce1 fei1 gwo3 san1 bin1 faat3 ceot1 sau1 sau1 sing1
